hero.title: Farming tools and services in one place
hero.subtitle: TerraByte connects farmers in Maharashtra with input sellers, equipment owners and agriculture experts, in English, Hindi and Marathi.

status.title: Project status
status.body: TerraByte is being rebuilt so that every number it shows comes from real data or a tested model. Features marked "In progress" still show demo data, clearly labelled.

accounts.title: Accounts for every role
accounts.description: Farmers start immediately; vendors, equipment owners and experts are verified by an admin before they can sign in.

languages.title: English, हिन्दी, मराठी
languages.description: Switch the language at any time from the top bar.

marketplace.title: Input marketplace
marketplace.description: Order seeds, fertilizers and tools from local vendors and track delivery.

rentals.title: Equipment rentals
rentals.description: Book tractors, sprayers and harvesters from owners in your district.

advice.title: Expert and KVK advice
advice.description: Ask agriculture experts and find your nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra.

fertilizer.title: Fertilizer dose from your soil test
fertilizer.description: Nutrient doses based on your Soil Health Card and official crop recommendations, with sources.

weather.title: Weather and irrigation
weather.description: Forecasts for your field's location and crop water needs.

prices.title: Mandi prices
prices.description: Daily APMC prices from official data, with honest forecasts only where they beat simple baselines.

disease.title: Crop disease check
disease.description: Photo-based leaf disease check that says "not sure" instead of guessing, with sourced treatment guidance.
